# Krasnikoff Studio

> Krasnikoff Studio designs and develops websites for companies: landing pages, company websites, product catalogs, and online stores.

The site is in Russian. The examples shown are design concepts, not claims about completed client projects.

## Main sections

- [Design examples](https://studio.krasnikoff.ru/#concepts): visual concepts for a clinic, restaurant, and interior studio.
- [Project process](https://studio.krasnikoff.ru/#process): the stages from discussing the project to launch.
- [Formats and prices](https://studio.krasnikoff.ru/#pricing): project types and starting prices.
- [Discuss a project](https://studio.krasnikoff.ru/#closing): contact the studio about a website.

## Services

- Landing page: from 39,900 ₽.
- Company website, up to five pages: from 69,900 ₽.
- Product catalog: from 99,000 ₽.
- Online store: from 149,000 ₽.

The final scope and price depend on the agreed project. Domain, platform plan, and integrations may be charged separately as described on the site.
